name: css-blocker
description: Prevents commits containing custom CSS files or inline styles

checks.name: block-css-files
args: cd /home/user/webapp && git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep -E '\.(css|scss|sass)$' | grep -v 'globals.css\|tokens.css' && exit 1 || exit 0

onFailure.message:
❌ BLOCKED: Custom CSS files detected!

⚠️ Absolute Rule: 커스텀 CSS 절대 금지 (NO custom CSS)
✅ Use ONLY Tailwind Plus utility classes

Blocked file patterns: .css, .scss, .sass (except globals.css, tokens.css)

To fix:
1. Remove custom CSS file
2. Convert styles to Tailwind utility classes
3. See: README-PLUGINS.md for guidance

checks.name: block-inline-styles
args: cd /home/user/webapp && git diff --cached -U0 | grep -E '^\+.*<style' && exit 1 || exit 0

onFailure.message:
❌ BLOCKED: Inline <style> tags detected!

⚠️ Absolute Rule: NO inline style tags allowed
✅ Use ONLY Tailwind utility classes in className prop

To fix:
1. Remove <style> tags
2. Convert to Tailwind classes in className
3. Example: className="flex items-center gap-2 ..."

checks.name: block-apply-directives
args: cd /home/user/webapp && git diff --cached -U0 -- src/**/*.css | grep -E '^\+.*@apply' && exit 1 || exit 0

onFailure.message:
⚠️ WARNING: @apply directive detected in CSS!

💡 Recommendation: Replace @apply with inline Tailwind utilities
✅ Preferred: className="inline-flex items-center ..."
❌ Avoid: .custom-class { @apply inline-flex items-center; }

This is a warning for now, but consider refactoring.

onSuccess.message: ✅ Tailwind Guard: No custom CSS violations detected
